sections.Profile:
Ding Dong and Smarty , released by Williams in 1968, are electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche. Both games share the same layout, with Ding Dong being the replay version and Smarty focusing on add-a-ball gameplay.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: School, Single Player, Good Times, Dual Theme, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Norm Clark
- Art: Christian Marche
sections.Editions:

- Smarty: 2,201 made, released 1968-02-01, model number 340
